95f0b0486a2d6fd6de4dd3d12bd6ae4db0427b65.pinyin: shǐ shū jiè shào le yān zhī de shēn fèn.
95f0b0486a2d6fd6de4dd3d12bd6ae4db0427b65.text: 史书介绍了阏氏的身份。

95f386fdce8b1d87bd7d0d91b74995f1f0a4fbaa.pinyin: tā wèi shòu wěi qu de tóng shì zhàng yì zhí yán.
95f386fdce8b1d87bd7d0d91b74995f1f0a4fbaa.text: 她为受委屈的同事仗义执言。

95f429da0319dc2d1e98491cdf7544bb9813b5aa.pinyin: mù jiàng bǎ fāng cái bān jìn cāng kù.

95f46e74048c04018754de2df58f2ac52a796f63.pinyin: tā de fáng zi zāo dào léi jī.

95f514f9124b43cd7996772520538249e9b82635.pinyin: wèi le cān jiā wǎn yàn, tā dǎ bàn de nóng zhuāng yàn mǒ.
95f514f9124b43cd7996772520538249e9b82635.text: 为了参加晚宴，她打扮得浓妆艳抹。

95fca2b815a4dad2b8568f40fb1b5676b3a39369.pinyin: tú zhōng biāo chū le féi cháng de wèi zhi.
95fca2b815a4dad2b8568f40fb1b5676b3a39369.text: 图中标出了腓肠的位置。

95fd3ea9863312d07d2e4d1a65b8393eeb7b0dee.pinyin: lǎo shī jǔ lì jiè shào zhè zhǒng yòng fǎ.
95fd3ea9863312d07d2e4d1a65b8393eeb7b0dee.text: 老师举例介绍这种用法。
